articles.summary: Aerial tramway would create a one-of-a-kind year-round mountain sightseeing experience offering accessible and iconic views of Glacier National Park and the surrounding Flathead Valley Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced that it has submitted a proposal to the U.S. Forest Service for a Special Use Permit for the development and operation of the Glacier View Tram, a sightseeing aerial tramway on the north slopes of Columbia Mountain in the Flathead National Forest near Hungry Horse, Montana and Glacier National Park. A conceptual rendering of the proposed Glacier View Tram. Design details are subject to change. The Glacier View Tram is being proposed as a year-round mountain sightseeing experience designed to connect people with the landscape, including visitors who cannot safely or practically reach higher elevations on foot. Consisting of two 100-passenger cabins, the tram would transport guests to a station just below the summit of Columbia
articles.title: Pursuit Submits Proposal to Develop Sightseeing Tram Near Glacier National Park
